designSummary: Narrative synthesis organised by failure point and approach; completion figures tabulated with their definitions and never pooled.
sampleSize: Not applicable: the unit is the published report. The pre-search retrieved seven relevant records, one of them a structured review of 37 reports, so about 40 to 60 eligible reports are expected; the synthesis describes ranges and patterns rather than a pooled estimate.
primaryAnalysis: For each approach, a table of completion with and without the approach, with window, denominator, finding types, setting and design; patterns across approaches described without vote counting.
secondaryAnalysis: Failure points mapped to the approaches that address them; results for patients without a primary care clinician, emergency-only patients and patients who need an interpreter reported wherever available; resources per approach where reported.
missingData: Reports without a completion denominator are described but left out of the completion table; missing subgroup results are recorded as not reported.
multiplicity: No statistical testing; approaches are not ranked by significance.
software: Reference manager and a shared extraction spreadsheet.
overfittingGuards: No pooling of completion figures with different windows or denominators
Every figure cited to the committee checked against its source record
Unverified leads listed separately and never cited as evidence
summary: Narrative synthesis without pooling; the number and comparability of reports, not a power calculation, limit what can be concluded.
